body:
Name of player being reported: BeastzWafflez Beastpancakez
Rule broken: Hacked client: Anti-Knockback (Both of them)
Evidence: Video Link
Anything else you would like to add?
>This video contains two small clips.
>The first one is a clip with Beastpancakez where I try to knock him off the edge as he bridges up. But he takes no KB. I know the first portion of the video is a bit low quality but as i die you can clearly see that it was beastpancakez.
>The Second clip is with beastzwafflez as he was tunneling under my base i heard him, I decided to follow him until I got into a position where i could knock him into the void. Sadly he also had Anti-Kb and was able to kill me.
>Salad.

Thank you!
